caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition on a textured, beige background resembling aged paper. At the top is a stylized cross in yellow ochre with a red outline and blue and red interior detailing, along with radiating yellow lines suggesting light. Below the cross is a bow-like shape with four oval loops, each outlined in blue and with red and yellow ochre inner coloring dotted by small red circles, centered around a small blue-and-yellow disc. Flanking the bow on both sides are two stylized, fan-shaped wings or feather-like appendages, rendered in yellow ochre and tipped with red. At the bottom and center of the composition is a large circular emblem, bordered in red, filled with an intricate, symmetric geometric pattern in red, blue, yellow ochre, and accents of white, resembling a sunburst or floral mandala. The entire arrangement is vertically aligned and made up of clear, bold shapes and earth-toned colors.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
